change.purpose: Isolated create-once canonical receipts for complete native slot-count claims, against independently retained bindings and body digest.
change.receipt_sha256_semantics: Digest of the canonical seven-field result body, excluding the added sha256 field and storage newline; not the whole-file checksum.

selection.scope: Explicitly selected literal-record/temporary-file engineering fixtures only; counts and timestamps describe execution bookkeeping, not scientific accuracy or business impact.

setup_correction.reason: Pytest tmp_path setup could not create the supplied basetemp because its worktree .runs parent was absent.
setup_correction.change: A separately retained corrected launcher creates only that parent before invoking pytest with a distinct fresh basetemp. Helper, test and configuration bytes are unchanged across attempts.

checked_engineering_obligations: Exact plain-container/scalar types and keys; all five independent binding identities; fixed supported execution declaration; complete class and total count arithmetic, including reserved predictions bounded by incorrect predictions.
Recorded runtime observation validation without querying or changing current numerical runtime; caller inputs captured before opening, fresh returned dictionaries and count boundary cases.
Canonical finite JSON plus one newline; independent body commitment rejects corruption and coherently rehashed substitutions.
Exclusive creation; short write, write, flush, fsync and reread failures propagate; existing or failed destinations remain without overwrite, cleanup or automatic recovery.

methods.startup: Child Python -I -S -B, explicit worktree and existing venv site-packages paths; automatic site initialization and .pth execution suppressed. Existing package initialization and NumPy dependencies remain; existing bytecode reads are possible.
methods.timeout_action: Attempt process-tree termination, bounded to five seconds, then wait up to five seconds; exceptional cleanup kills the immediate child with a bounded wait. These branches were source-reviewed, not fault-injected.
methods.authoritative_outcome: Retained result.json with exact JUnit case identities and outcomes, exit status and before/after content identities; ordinary pytest failure propagates as shell failure.

scientific_boundary.scientific_identities: null in the unchanged scientific draft
scientific_boundary.unresolved: Scientific ownership/API and complete eleven-entry seal with every training/condition/stage terminal; verification before holdout generation/registration/forward; one aggregate registry attempt for eight lineages including failed parents; integration of full-slot persistence and durable reservation/observation joins after callback return or unwinding; failures, unknown outcomes, aliases and all 880 proposed logical slot attributions.

trust_and_scope_limits: Literal engineering records and temporary files supply persistence checks only; no trained study, historical replay, data generation, scientific selection/admission, native evaluator or registry authorization was run.

The body digest must be independently retained; embedded hashes alone do not reject a coherently rehashed substitution. Recorded runtime declarations and valid bytes do not attest execution or provenance.
A complete canonical file can remain after flush/fsync/reread failure. A later successful reader establishes byte/schema/commitment correspondence, not that the original writer returned successfully.
Pre-open lstat/link/reparse checks do not protect against concurrent filesystem replacement, establish independently owned storage or guarantee power-loss durability.

Source/runtime identities are partial inventories, not complete dependency or execution attestation, a sandbox, historical lock agreement, a performance advantage, scientific utility or business impact.

Private capture commitments bind retained bytes only. Absolute local paths, raw logs, environment values and per-case durations are omitted. UTC attempt start/finish timestamps are retained solely as execution bookkeeping.

Local execution does not verify later documentation/publication edits. Hosted checks/review are separate post-commit evidence; the receipt helper does not establish scientific admission or a durable registry join.
